## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and my branch is current with `main`.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for new behavior.
- [ ] I updated affected documentation.
- [ ] I did not commit secrets, credentials, account IDs, or personal paths.
- [ ] I did not commit generated backtests, notebook secrets, or large datasets.
- [ ] New data has documented provenance and a reproducible refresh path.
- [ ] New Python and notebook code is syntactically valid.
- [ ] I reviewed AI-assisted changes and can explain the submitted code.
- [ ] I reviewed notebook outputs and removed sensitive or unnecessary output.
- [ ] I disclosed any trading-behavior or ObjectStore schema change above.
